name: Behalf.bot - FounderOS
description: A gated coach for early-stage founders. It walks a founder through a fixed sequence of stages, from why and founder fit through audience, pain research, discovery, solution test, positioning, content, validation and traction. Each stage ends in a gate that needs ledger evidence, not self-report. Content (framework cards, concept notes, stage skills, gate specs) is markdown in git; founder state lives in a ledger behind a storage interface. This release is the scaffold only: no skills, cards or gates ship yet.

enabled.description: Master switch. The plugin ships no skills yet, so enabling it does nothing beyond running setup.sh and validate.sh.

include_contrib.description: Load community cards from contrib/ in addition to core/. Off by default: the coach loads only core/, and founders never see contrib content unless the operator opts in.

activation._note: Scaffold release. Stage skills are invoked on demand once they ship; there are no scheduled jobs.

system.name: python3
system.install: apt-get install python3 (Debian) / your platform's package manager
system._explanation: validate.sh parses the manifest with python3. Later releases add a stdlib-only content lint and the ledger storage interface, both Python.
